# duploai_ssm_parameter (Resource)

Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS Systems Manager (SSM) Parameter Store parameter, provisioned within an environment and resource group. Every in-place update rewrites the value, so it creates a new parameter version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A plain-text parameter
resource "duploai_ssm_parameter" "db_host" {
  workspace_id      = "<workspace-id>"
  environment_id    = "<environment-id>"
  resource_group_id = "<resource-group-id>"

  name        = "/myapp/dev/db-host"
  type        = "String"
  value       = "db.internal.example.com"
  description = "Database host for the dev environment"

  tags = [
    { key = "team", value = "platform" },
  ]
}

# A comma-separated list
resource "duploai_ssm_parameter" "allowed_origins" {
  workspace_id      = "<workspace-id>"
  environment_id    = "<environment-id>"
  resource_group_id = "<resource-group-id>"

  name  = "/myapp/dev/allowed-origins"
  type  = "StringList"
  value = "https://app.example.com,https://admin.example.com"
}

# An encrypted parameter with a customer-managed KMS key
resource "duploai_ssm_parameter" "db_password" {
  workspace_id      = "<workspace-id>"
  environment_id    = "<environment-id>"
  resource_group_id = "<resource-group-id>"

  name   = "/myapp/dev/db-password"
  type   = "SecureString"
  value  = "<secret-value>"
  key_id = "<kms-key-id>" # omit to use the AWS-managed alias/aws/ssm
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment in which the parameter is created.
- `name` (String) Parameter name: a simple name such as `db-host`, or a hierarchical path that starts with `/`, such as `/myapp/dev/db-host`. Lowercase only, because the platform stores names in lowercase. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `resource_group_id` (String) ID of the resource group in which the parameter is created. Its AWS account and region are used.
- `type` (String) Parameter type: String (plain text), StringList (comma-separated values, plain text) or SecureString (encrypted with AWS KMS). Changing the type of an existing parameter is not supported yet: a change after creation is not applied. To change it, replace the parameter (e.g. `terraform apply -replace=<address>`).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Parameter value. For StringList, a comma-separated list such as `a,b,c`. Refreshed from AWS (decrypted for SecureString), so a change made outside Terraform shows as drift; if AWS cannot be read, the value already in state is kept. The value is stored in Terraform state.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace that owns this parameter.

### Optional

- `allowed_pattern` (String) Regular expression that AWS checks the value against on every write, e.g. `^\d+$` for digits only. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current pattern.
- `data_type` (String) Data type AWS validates the value as: text (default), aws:ec2:image (an AMI ID) or aws:ssm:integration.
- `description` (String) Description stored on the parameter in AWS. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current description.
- `failure_retries` (Number) Number of extra polls to tolerate a transient failure status during provisioning before treating it as terminal. Overrides the resource's default; leave unset to use it.
- `key_id` (String) SecureString only. KMS key that encrypts the value: a key ID, ARN or alias. Defaults to the AWS-managed key `alias/aws/ssm`. Updating the key of an existing parameter is not supported yet: a change after creation is ignored and the parameter keeps its original key. To use a different key, replace the parameter (e.g. `terraform apply -replace=<address>`).
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags applied to the parameter at creation. Platform ownership tags and the resource group's tags are added automatically. Set only at creation (SSM does not accept tags when a parameter is updated). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `tier` (String) Storage tier: Standard (values up to 4 KB, free), Advanced (up to 8 KB, charged) or Intelligent-Tiering (AWS picks Standard or Advanced on each write). Defaults to Standard. With Intelligent-Tiering, AWS reports the tier it resolved to; that is not shown as a change, so a tier changed outside Terraform is not detected while Intelligent-Tiering is configured. Changing Advanced back to Standard fails at apply because AWS does not allow it; replace the parameter instead (e.g. `terraform apply -replace=<address>`).
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) ARN of the parameter in AWS.
- `id` (String) Composite resource identifier (workspace_id/id).
- `last_modified_date` (String) When the parameter was last written (RFC 3339, UTC, second precision).
- `ssm_parameter_id` (String) ID of this parameter, for reference by dependent resources.
- `status` (String) Current provisioning status.
- `version` (Number) Current parameter version. AWS increments it on every write.

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing SSM parameter.
#  - WORKSPACE_ID is the unique identifier of the workspace (e.g. 69b2aa30675718845bfe87a0)
#  - SSM_PARAMETER_ID is the unique identifier of the parameter (e.g. 6a2258e94703bc957a1b824e)
terraform import duploai_ssm_parameter.db_host WORKSPACE_ID/SSM_PARAMETER_ID
# Example:
# terraform import duploai_ssm_parameter.db_host 69b2aa30675718845bfe87a0/6a2258e94703bc957a1b824e
```
